module: Flowgraph node 'Linear Smoother' (simple category). Linear smoothing of a signal with newTemporalSmoothing: 'value' toward the internal state at speed upRate (rising) or downRate (falling), with time step 'dt'. 'set' forces the state. Output 'value'. The pin descriptions are 'TODO' in the code.
notes: init writes C.oldSet (class) instead of self.oldSet: shared between instances.
The C.todo field in the code says 'Requires testing and should have flow pins'.
dt is nil if the pin is not connected.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

checkSetValue.desc: If 'set' changed, forces the smoother state to that value.

work.desc: With no input, outputs the current state; otherwise chooses the rate (upRate/downRate, default 1) and outputs smoother:getWithRateUncapped(sample, dt, rate).
